why: An outpost Defend's loss budget is priced as it commits and only a re-form re-prices it, so its losses past the budget end it: our bot in three mutually hostile seats, where alpha camps the exit beta's E18S6 Defend enters by. On the old rule every death re-priced the budget to losses so far plus the predicted dead, so the bound was never crossed: beta's Defend opened t4631 (priced a win losing 1) counted 52 lost (about 15 bodies dead, the rest spent bodies healed and drafted again) by t5355, its casts walking in one at a time. Each Defend in every seat, at whichever tick it opens, loses at most the bodies of the tick it quits on past its budget (defend 3 there: 47 past it on 8c0c5ded, before the fix; at most 0 on seeds 1-5 after, every seat opening Defends on every seed). Bodies lost over the run, each seat, are the engine's kills of every body its engagements drew, held or released, bounded at seed 1's (alpha 7, beta 9 since source posts never part their tiles, gamma 13, 8-10 before casts landed off their spawns in series: the runs part at t4307, a sweep priced to land later, and every added death is a sweep harasser released disarmed; beta 7 before the home Defend's casts ranked ahead of an outpost's): fight losses, mostly bodies disarmed in the fight and finished as they leave it. Self-play, since only our own Defend's accounting is read.
